reading.title: Example Research Employee saved-research lookup needs six Discord responses and splits the assessment mid-sentence
reading.impact: To understand why Cedar Cooperative is not qualified, the user had to issue six separate ephemeral page commands. The first page showed only decision values; the rationale broke mid-sentence and the hypotheses heading was separated from its items. The prospect alternative produced no attachment.
reading.expected: One concise first response with entity, usable reference URL, saved-research label, assessment date, conclusion, reason, key uncertainty and next action, plus direct access to the complete assessment (facts, hypotheses, unanswered questions and sources) without manual page commands, whether or not attachments are permitted.
reproduction: In the configured channel, run `/bd research entity:Cedar Cooperative page:1` (the path offered by `/bd help` and the summary follow-up).
Follow the `page:2` … `page:6` follow-ups to read the rationale, facts, hypotheses, next action and open questions.
Optionally run `/bd prospect name:Cedar Cooperative page:1` and look for an attached report.
reading.source_explanation: Fictional source reading: the scenario's detail pages pack one paragraph per line into 850 characters, so the 939-character rationale cannot follow the header, and the research command attaches no file. Why the prospect attachment was absent in the scenario is unverified.
reading.retest: After the fix is deployed, run `/bd research entity:Cedar Cooperative` once and choose the complete-reading control. Copy the first response and every complete-reading response in full (or save the file), record the revision, then run `python -m seren_harness review-workflow --case cases/scott-saved-research-reading.json --evidence <bundle.json> --state-dir <state> --out <new dir> --retest <finding key>` with an attributed operator assessment.
